overall: The AG found neither the Board of Aldermen nor the School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law in electing its presiding officer, crediting the denials and finding the Board's individual candidate outreach was sporadic and not a serial quorum.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting to choose its president through private candidacy outreach to members.
allegations.key_passage: On balance, the evidence does not support a finding that the Board deliberated outside of a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the School Committee deliberated outside a posted meeting to choose its chair.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Committee deliberated outside of a meeting before it elected Kristin Thorp as its chair on December 11, 2012.
